headline: Red Sox snatch a gritty win in Texas to stay alive
morning_brew: I watched that game against the Rangers through my fingers like it was a low-budget horror movie, but seeing us come out on top was a massive relief for my blood pressure. We were trailing early and the bats looked like they were swinging in wet cement until we finally woke up late in the game. That is the kind of win that makes you feel like a genius for sitting through the slog, and it was nice to see this team keep their heads and grind it out instead of pulling their usual vanishing act when the heat is on.

Sonny Gray was a horse, grinding through six and a third innings on the mound and keeping us within striking distance while the Rangers threatened to blow it wide open. I have been ready to scream at the television because of the bullpen lately, but the arson squad actually took the night off and earned their real name back by locking the door. Wyatt Olds picked up the win, and Garrett Whitlock slammed the gate shut in the ninth, which is the kind of clean, drama-free finish that I have been craving all month.

We are headed to Tampa for a massive series starting tonight, and I am not gonna breathe easy until we secure that wild card spot for good. My old man always said you don't start popping the champagne until the job is finished, and with only nine games left in the season, this is no time to act like we've arrived. I just want to see us play with that same intensity in Florida, because the math is simple and every single win is another small deposit in the Duck Boat fund.

news_digest.headline: MLB playoff picture 2026: Clinching scenarios, bracket, schedule
news_digest.dans_take: It's getting crowded in the bracket, so we have to keep winning before someone else takes our seat.

news_digest.headline: MLB playoffs 2026: Fatal October flaws for every contender
news_digest.dans_take: Every team in the league has a hole, I just hope ours isn't the one that sends us home.
